name: Cervical Whiplash-Associated Disorder
definition: Clinical syndrome after acceleration-deceleration neck trauma, most commonly motor-vehicle collision, ranging from neck pain/stiffness to neurological symptoms depending on injury severity.

redFlags.item: Severe midline tenderness with high-risk trauma

investigations.principle: Use validated cervical-spine trauma decision rules for imaging decisions.
investigations.MRI: CT is preferred for high-risk acute bony injury; MRI for cord/ligament/neurological concerns.
investigations.radiographs: Plain radiographs have a limited role depending on setting and guideline.

amber: Avoid prolonged immobilization in uncomplicated WAD; persistent severe symptoms require reassessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Greeva-abhighata phenotype may be documented while modern trauma screening remains primary.

patientEducation.summary: Clinical syndrome after acceleration-deceleration neck trauma, most commonly motor-vehicle collision, ranging from neck pain/stiffness to neurological symptoms depending on injury severity.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for severe/progressive neurological deficit, vascular compromise, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
